provenance.samplePolicy: 12 rounds, first 2 warmups excluded from summaries; p95 nearest rank; local servedSha=dev is not Git provenance
provenance.depthPolicy: Longest observed non-overlapping invocation chain; not measured remote geography or causal proof
provenance.datasetPolicy: Same persisted local D1; representative and stress workspaces coexist; workspace workload is 3x, not whole-database byte size
provenance.sensitiveData: No SQL, bind values, row payloads, resource IDs, credentials, request URLs or identity data
